name: marker
title: Marker
description: A step in a conversation or activity timeline in the Code voice: a glyph cell and words, a separator between seams, or a keyline under the words; pending runs the pending segment and is a polite status.
whenToUse: Use it for a step in an activity timeline, a divider between days or messages, or work still in progress. For a state label use Status.

parts.name: Marker
parts.description: A step in a conversation or activity timeline: "Searched the web", "Assigned to DHL Freight", "Yesterday". Not a message: it sits between messages in the Code voice. - default: a glyph cell (MarkerIcon) then the words. - `variant="separator"`: the words between two seams (a day or "New messages" divider). - `variant="border"`: a keyline under the words (the head of a run of steps). - `pending`: work in progress ("Thinking…"): the pending segment runs under the words, never a spinner, and the marker becomes a polite status so the change is announced. Drop `pending` when the step is done.

props.name: pending
props.description: Work in progress: the pending segment runs under the words and the marker is a polite status.

parts.name: MarkerIcon
parts.description: A 16px glyph cell (authored SVG or a Status glyph), hidden from assistive tech.
